evidence.observation: Tube pressure keeps rising through growth, 3.044→3.070→3.122→3.209 Torr, with steady ramp baseline ~2.96 Torr
Exhaust O2 keeps rising, 12→16→20.7→27.2 ppm, up from ~6-8 ppm during the ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the extra pressure is not coming from the argon supply
Temperature settled at setpoint 750°C after a small overshoot, so the thermocouple and heater look normal

args.missing_evidence: No normal-run ref values for comparison. A leak-rate check (isolate the pump and watch how fast pressure rises) or leak-checking the flanges would confirm seal_leak and rule out exhaust_blockage. Blockage would raise pressure but should not bring in O2.
